docstring:
Heath-Brown [He88] has proved that all large numbers are the sum of at most three
$2$-powerful numbers.

This is the case $r = 2$ of `Erdos1107.erdos_1107`, which asks the same question with $r + 1$
summands, and it is stated there as `Erdos1107.erdos_1107.variants.two`.
references: [BaBr94] Baker, R. C. and Brüdern, J., _On sums of two squarefull numbers_. Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. (1994), 1-5.
[He88](https://oeis.org/A187054) Heath-Brown, D. R., _Ternary quadratic forms and sums of three square-full numbers_. (1988), 137-163.
type_pretty: ∀ᶠ (x : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ S, S.card ≤ 3 ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, Nat.Full 2 s) ∧ x = S.sum
